ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of Bread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose this for mellow, melodic songs that fit my Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Platinum Collection: Greatest Hits I, II & III; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Queen fits my classic rock interest, but I feel more like softer music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Jump Back: Best Of The Rolling Stones 1971-1993; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my classic rock compilations, but I would pass over its harder edge today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis 30 #1 Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in older hits, though other choices feel closer to my current listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Fleetwood Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose this for melodic rock and an accessible greatest-hits selection, consistent with my compilation listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Huey Lewis Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Upbeat eighties pop rock is less appealing right now than the folk and sixties sounds in my history.
ItemID: NA; Title: Journey Greatest Hits       explicit_lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Arena rock feels less suited to my current mood than gentler, song-focused selections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Best of Bowie; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in classic rock and pop makes this appealing, but it would not be my first pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sounds of Summer: Very Best of The Beach Boys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose this because its sixties melodies and vocal harmonies fit my AM Gold and Beatles listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Carole King Tapestry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I'd choose this first for warm vocals and melodic songwriting that fit my Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie listening.
